description: List all transit agencies served by this OneBusAway instance. Returns agency IDs, names, contact info, timezone, and geographic coverage center. Agency IDs are needed for onebusaway_list_routes_for_agency and onebusaway_get_vehicles.
name: onebusaway_list_agencies

agencies.description: All agencies served by this OneBusAway instance.

items.description: A transit agency with coverage information.

coverageCenter.description: Geographic center of the agency's service area.

coverageSpan.description: Geographic extent of the agency's service area.

latSpan.description: Latitude span of the coverage area in degrees.

lonSpan.description: Longitude span of the coverage area in degrees.

id.description: Agency ID used in other calls (e.g. "1" for Metro Transit).

phone.description: Agency phone number, or null if not provided.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `rate_limited`: No upstream request slot opened within the queue wait cap, or OneBusAway returned a rate limit response. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

limitExceeded.description: True if the upstream capped the agency list — some agencies were omitted. This endpoint has no pagination to retrieve them.

notice.description: Guidance when no agencies were returned.

title: List Transit Agencies
